title: Study of Post Menopausal Osteoporosis (PMO) Among Gynecology Outpatients in Pakistan
brief_summary: This observational study will provide an opportunity to document local patterns of susceptibility, patient profile, and usefulness of screening in postmenopausal patients coming to gynecology outpatient clinics in Pakistan. This will also capture the initial management of PMO in diagnosed patients. The information gathered will serve as a foundation for developing national guidelines on screening and management of PMO in Pakistan.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Postmenopausal women
* Age 50 years or greater

Exclusion Criteria:

* Previously diagnosed osteoporosis, or receiving treatment for osteoporosis
study_population: The study will enroll gynecology outpatients in Pakistan who meet eligibility criteria for observation.
